answer: An agent economy can price out Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to lock a bond tied to a verified operator. Faking a thousand voters then means locking 500,000 units before a single vote counts. The atlas registry links bonds that share a funding path, so a cluster draining from one source gets flagged. Like a river feeding many channels, the money still traces back to one origin. Even a whisper of synchronized timing across accounts can trigger review.
